payload.text: After the compact, on vc's word: file the 0.1.35 candidate's WSL red (run 45956129632, releasecut.bats's 0335 arm, test 2353) as an issue, with a trace that proves the cause: I14a851d's free-space rule empties a cache whose disk has less than release.gate_cache.max (12G) free, and the arm sets no bound.
